dedupe_keys.name: localisation des digues sur la ville d anglet

description: Localisation des digues sur la ville d'Anglet is a dataset listed in Anglet Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ville d'Anglet. Jeu de données recense les digues, remblais longitudinaux le plus souvent composés de terre. La fonction principale de cet ouvrage est d'empêcher la submersion des basses-terres se trouvant le long de la digue par les eaux d'un lac, d'une rivière ou de l'océan. Coverage: Anglet. The portal files it under Environnement. Its keywords are digues, protection, ouvrages, submersion. The portal shows 111 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2020-01-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-anglet-opendatapaysbasque-portal.
